test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions that follow by selecting the most appropriate option from the given alternatives.

Artificial Intelligence (AI) is gradually transforming the way students learn. From virtual tutors to personalized learning paths, Al helps identify each learner's strengths and weaknesses. With the help of data, Al systems can suggest specific topics where student
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage highlights both the **benefits** (personalized learning, chatbots, efficiency) and the **risks** (loss of problem-solving skills, data privacy issues) of using AI in education.
 
• The author clearly states that **AI can be a useful tool when used wisely**, emphasizing that neither complete dependence nor total avoidance is ideal.
 
• Therefore, the author’s final advice is to **balance human guidance with machine efficiency**.
 
• This matches with **Option 3: Balance tech and human input**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Replace teachers** – Incorrect, the author does not suggest eliminating teachers.
 
• **Option 2: Use only AI** – Incorrect, over-dependence is warned against.
 
• **Option 4: Avoid all AI** – Incorrect, the author acknowledges the usefulness of AI.
